features.description: Second-person plural pronoun or address form.
features.safe_example: Y'all can see why the character returns.
features.blocked_context: Do not insert when no second-person reference exists.

features.description: Near-future marker roughly meaning about to.
features.safe_example: She is fixin' to try again.
features.blocked_context: Do not use unless the anchor expresses an upcoming action.

features.description: Regional verb meaning think or suppose.
features.safe_example: I reckon the author wanted to show hope.

features.description: Regional expression with context-dependent pragmatic meaning.
features.blocked_context: Avoid in benchmark generation unless the team explicitly approves the pragmatic context.
Do not use if completion is not part of the original meaning.

features.description: Stacked modal construction such as might could.
features.safe_example: She might could take the test again.
features.blocked_context: Do not add uncertainty if the anchor states certainty.

features.description: Use of anymore in non-negative contexts.
features.safe_example: People use computers for many things anymore.
features.blocked_context: Use only when it does not change time/aspect meaning.
Avoid phonetic spelling unless team approves an orthographic perturbation condition.

safety_notes: Do not make the student sound less intelligent or less educated.
